reduced.hidden_state_convention: HF tuple: embeddings, intermediate block inputs, final normalized output

attention.sparsity_threshold: mean normalized head-mean probability over valid causal pairs; strict less-than; our frozen convention
attention.normalization: validate raw valid-query probabilities first; zero masked keys; FP32 row-renormalize allowed keys
attention.query_aggregation: unweighted mean across valid queries; previous bias excludes first valid query
attention.pair_domain: valid query/key positions with original key index <= original query index
attention.special_token_policy: include all nonpadding input positions, matching Reduced hidden features
